failureMessage: every Google-issued ID token shares that issuer, so signature + issuer alone accept a token minted for any Google OAuth client — the audience claim is the only thing that scopes a token to this app, and an unset audience is a full authentication bypass

matchLines.what: declares the Google accounts issuer with no (or an explicitly empty) expected audience
matchLines.fix: configure the validator's audience to your exact OAuth web-application client id, next to the issuer; never leave it unset

failureMessage: a Google ID token carries email regardless of verification — an action gated on the bare claim trusts an address Google has not verified; and behind an API Gateway JWT authorizer the claim arrives as a string, so a strict boolean compare silently rejects every genuinely-verified user

matchLines.what: reads the token's email claim but never checks email_verified
matchLines.fix: gate any identity-bearing action on the email_verified claim being true (behind an API Gateway JWT authorizer it arrives as the string 'true')

matchLines.what: compares email_verified to a boolean with strict equality behind an API Gateway authorizer
matchLines.fix: compare against the string 'true' (or coerce) — the authorizer stringifies claims, so a strict boolean compare rejects every verified user
